issues.reason: Compound concepts makes modifier-genus exposure determined, not optional, and licenses it only for a gradable, positional/cardinal, or material adjective predicable of the referent — the relational "sporting" fails the predication test ("the passion is sporting"), so (Inheritance sporting_passion sporting) is emitted against the rule.

The issue mistakes a coverage gap for a defect: Ordinal needs a <scale> the sentence does not supply (the reviewer's own second gap), and a positional/cardinal adjective predicated of an individual witness by Member is the same treatment the compound rule gives east_wing → east, so nothing false or ill-typed is emitted.

Names and casing states mechanically that an appositive has no tense of its own and its typing atom takes the host clause's wrapper — the host "traded" is past, so the dash-set appositive must be (Past (Member sk_passion_1 australian_rules_football)).

The missing (Name wimbledon "Wimbledon") half stands (a symbol plus exactly one Name fact is non-optional for any proper noun), but requiring the compound to be dissolved is overstated — the section's proper-noun exclusion is about multi-word names, the Brindle-estuary route would falsely type Wimbledon as a defence, and no head links a defence to the place, which is the reviewer's own first gap.

gaps_confirmed: A proper noun modifying a common-noun head where the referent is NOT the named entity ("his Wimbledon defence"): the Names section covers only the kind-word-names-the-same-entity case, so the name's symbol cannot be kept and linked.
An ordinal modifier on a noun with no associated event and no explicit "-est" dimension to fill Ordinal's <scale> slot ("his first sporting passion").
new_gaps: The appositive-wrapper rule is stated inside the copular tense section; that a past VERBAL host also wraps a dash-set appositive's typing atom follows from "past host" but is nowhere spelled out.

A relational adjective in a fused compound ("sporting passion") classifies the head but is not predicable, so it fuses under the term-of-art line yet has no exposure branch — the rule reaches the right answer only by the predication test failing.
repair_summary: Dropped the unlicensed modifier genus (Inheritance sporting_passion sporting); wrapped the appositive typing atom as (Past (Member sk_passion_1 australian_rules_football)); added (: td22_wimbledon_name (Name wimbledon "Wimbledon") (STV 1.0 0.99)) before the defence atoms.
notes: wimbledon_defence is kept because dissolving it would either falsely type Wimbledon as a defence or lose the modifier with no licensed head to restate it. The event skeleton (trade/For, deictic yesterday, During, Before onto the anchor noun) needed no change.
